items.title: Bread Basket with Butter and Jam
items.alt: A woven basket holds a scored round loaf, baguette and twisted rolls beside butter, red jam and a knife.
items.description: A folded striped cloth gathers the bread spread into one low arrangement, with the wooden-handled knife resting clear of the basket.

items.title: Chocolate Fondue with Fruit and Marshmallows
items.alt: An ivory chocolate fondue pot stands above a candle beside strawberries, banana slices, marshmallows and dipping forks.
items.description: The dark metal stand supports the two-handled pot, while a separate small plate keeps the two long forks together.

items.title: Sharing a Turkey Dinner with a Wheelchair User
items.alt: A woman in a rust apron passes a turkey dinner to a smiling man in a blue sweater using a wheelchair.
items.description: The pair supports opposite edges of the meal plate, with bread and cranberry sauce carried close to the serving woman’s arm.

items.title: Ribbon Pasta Served in a Cheese Wheel
items.alt: Ribbon pasta with basil and cherry tomatoes fills an open cheese wheel beside rolls and a green salad.
items.description: The thick pale rind forms the serving bowl, with the smaller bread plate and clear salad bowl completing the rounded spread.

items.title: Bear Pulling a Turkey Feast Wagon Coloring Page
items.alt: A smiling cartoon bear in a waistcoat and bow tie pulls a wagon with roast turkey, pie and a roll basket in black outline.
items.description: The full walking bear, pull handle and wheeled wooden cart form one cheerful horizontal scene with open coloring areas.

items.title: Turtle Pulling a Picnic Cart Coloring Page
items.alt: A smiling turtle pulls a wooden cart loaded with watermelon, sandwiches and a pitcher in black outline.
items.description: The patterned shell and complete wheeled cart create a separate picnic character scene with clear, unshaded coloring spaces.
